summary: Validated this iteration's two new features: (1) local-only receipts via MongoDB GridFS and (2) scheduled nightly backups + full server-backup management. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_backup_gridfs.py -> 23/23 PASSED (GridFS upload/list/download/delete + attachment_count flag; GET/PUT /api/settings/backup incl. '99:99' -> 400; POST /api/backups/run, GET /api/backups, DELETE /api/backups/{name}, GET /api/backups/{name}/download (Bearer + ?auth=), POST /api/backups/{name}/restore; retention <=N enforced; path-traversal payloads ('../etc/passwd', '..%2Fetc%2Fpasswd', 'foo/bar.json', 'no-prefix.json', 'church-treasury-backup-../x.json') all rejected 400/404 on download/delete/restore; Viewer gets 403 on GET/PUT /settings/backup, GET /backups and POST /backups/run). Frontend: Settings -> Backup tab renders the new 'Automatic Nightly Backups' card with backup-enabled-switch, backup-time-input, backup-retention-input, btn-save-backup-cfg, btn-run-backup-now; changing time to 03:30 and retention to 3 persisted (GET /settings/backup returns the same); btn-run-backup-now adds a backup-row-<name> to Saved Backups and btn-download/restore/delete appear per row; delete removes the row. Transactions: '+ New Entry' dialog shows attachment-input; set_input_files uploaded a 1x1 PNG and the pending file appeared in the Receipts list; opening the existing 'receipt test' transaction via the pencil icon shows btn-view-attachment-<id> + btn-delete-attachment-<id>, view opens a blob URL served by GET /api/attachments/{id}/download. The paperclip indicator renders on the transaction row.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent — Switch component used in backup-enabled-switch was not imported, causing a runtime ReferenceError ('Switch is not defined') that crashed the entire Settings page as soon as the Backup tab tried to render. Added `import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/switch';` at top of Settings.js. After the fix, the whole Backup tab works correctly.

action_items: Review the Switch import fix added to /app/frontend/src/pages/Settings.js (line 12). Consider adding an ESLint rule / smoke-render test to catch missing imports on new Settings tabs.
critical_code_review_comments: Scheduled-backup endpoints uniformly require require_data (data.manage) — viewer correctly gets 403. Good.
_safe_backup_name() strictly whitelists BACKUP_PREFIX + no '/' or '..' — download/delete/restore all funnel through it. Path-traversal tests all rejected. Good.
Backup time validation rejects '99:99' at the Pydantic layer (returns 400) — good.
Retention cleanup fires inside run_backup() after each write; test with retention=2 + 4 runs ended with len(/api/backups) <= 2. Good.
GridFS: fs_bucket = AsyncIOMotorGridFSBucket(db,'receipts'). upload uses upload_from_stream, download uses open_download_stream, delete removes the blob — zero cloud deps, matches spec.
Download endpoint accepts either Authorization: Bearer or ?auth=<jwt> query — both verified. 401 when unauthenticated.
Minor nit: Settings.js is >600 lines and now has a 4th sub-tab in Backup — splitting BackupTab into its own file would make missing-import regressions less likely.
Minor nit: /api/backups returns only {name, size, mtime} — a count field in the response (or a dedicated /api/backups?summary) would simplify the UI retention indicator.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of targeted flows after the Switch-import fix (backup card persistence, Back Up Now adds row, row actions, Delete removes row, receipt attach + view)

rca of the issue: Switch-import omission in Settings.js — RCA: BackupTab was extended with the new Automatic Nightly Backups card that uses <Switch/> from shadcn, but the import was never added. Because React only resolves the identifier at render time, the error only surfaces when BackupTab mounts (i.e. the Backup tab is opened), making it invisible to a basic 'did the app load' smoke test. Reproduction: log in -> Settings -> Backup tab -> runtime error 'Switch is not defined' from static/js/bundle.js, Settings page becomes unusable. Mitigation applied: added `import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/switch';` to /app/frontend/src/pages/Settings.js. All 7 tab-related testids become visible, backup save/run/delete flows all pass end-to-end.
